title: Vision completes only acknowledged full-height desktop and phone coverage
steps: Run the stream parser, capture route, full-height vision consumer and real-browser coverage cases.
Exercise malformed fault JSON, partial view, range gaps, checksum corruption, missing terminal, slow consumers, queue cancellation and height exhaustion.
expect: A 10604px page reaches the model input from top through footer at both widths, with at most three tiles plus one image-input check and 4MiB JSON per model call.
Malformed or incomplete evidence cannot PASS; successful partial views and real faults remain. Cancellation closes owned contexts before queue handoff; ordinary screenshot API stays JSON.
Missing or wrong imageCode prevents accepting labels and acknowledging tiles; pre-verification labels are not reused.
evidence: Capture fixture reproduced looked=true with one of four required page/viewport pairs decoded before the fix.
fence: Coverage is derived from required layouts and both viewports, then acknowledged only after decoding/sending and a valid model verdict.

tests: every selected page and both widths are streamed through the footer, with three tiles plus one input check per model call
a partial phone capture retains coverage and real faults from the other three complete views
Node HTTP adapter propagates a disconnected slow consumer back to generator cleanup
valid-looking labels without the image-only code are never trusted
a clean verdict without a readable image code cannot acknowledge any tiles
labels from before image-input verification are not reused or exposed
